title: selectiveLogic `or` is a legacy alias of `and`, not 'either'
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:47 - "`and` = primary + at least one secondary; `and_all` = primary + **all** secondary keys; `or` = either; `not`/`not_all` negate."
reality: Primary keys must always match first: keyword-scanner.ts:649-653 (`if (!matched) { tryDecisionTrigger(); continue; }`). testSecondaryKeys (packages/shared/src/utils/lorebook-keyword-matching.ts:121-133): `and` and `or` both = some secondary matches; `and_all` = every secondary matches; `not` = no secondary matches; `not_all` = not every secondary matches. The drawer offers only AND Any / AND All / NOT Any / NOT All (packages/client/src/components/lorebooks/LorebookEntryRow.tsx:166-171) and shows a stored `or` as AND Any (line 1688). Secondary keys alone never activate an entry. The secondary test also gates semantic matches (keyword-scanner.ts:736-742).
fix: lorebooks.md entry table, selectiveLogic row: 'Primary keys must match first. `and` (UI **AND Any**) = plus at least one secondary; `and_all` (**AND All**) = plus every secondary; `not` (**NOT Any**) = plus no secondary; `not_all` (**NOT All**) = plus not every secondary. `or` is a legacy value that behaves exactly like `and` (shown as AND Any); secondary keys never trigger an entry on their own. The secondary test applies to semantic (vector) matches too.'

title: GET /api/lorebooks/:id returns no entries; API list missing the entries route and v2.5.0 routes
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:404 - "`GET /api/lorebooks/:id` — one lorebook (with entries)"; API Endpoints list (401-412) lists only 9 routes
reality: packages/server/src/routes/lorebooks.routes.ts:480-484 returns storage.getById, which goes through hydrateLorebookRows (services/storage/lorebooks.storage.ts:317-373) and adds only characterIds/personaIds, not entries. Entries come from GET /api/lorebooks/:id/entries (routes:667, optional ?sourceMessageId=) and GET /:id/entries/:entryId (684). Unlisted routes: POST /:id/entries/bulk (bulk create, 794), PATCH /:id/entries/bulk (batch settings, up to 5000 ids, 711), POST /:id/entries/bulk-edit (821), POST /:id/entries/bulk-delete (842), POST /:id/entries/transfer (851), PUT /:id/entries/reorder (922), /:id/folders CRUD + clone + reorder (943-1001), POST /:id/entries/:entryId/images (757), POST /:id/vectorize and DELETE /:id/vectors (1403, 1543), GET /:id/activation-stats (1391), GET /scan/:chatId (1028), POST /bulk-enabled (506), POST /export-bulk (605). GET /:id/export defaults to the native `marinara_lorebook` envelope; `?format=compatible` gives a folderless World Info JSON (routes:139-142, 575-603).
fix: lorebooks.md API Endpoints: change to 'GET /api/lorebooks/:id — one lorebook (settings plus linked character/persona ids; no entries)'; add 'GET /api/lorebooks/:id/entries — list entries (?sourceMessageId= filter)'; add one compact line naming the bulk (bulk, bulk-edit, bulk-delete, transfer, reorder), folders, entry images, vectorize/vectors and activation-stats routes; note `?format=compatible` on export.

reality: lorebookBaseSchema (packages/shared/src/schemas/lorebook.schema.ts:137-179) and the Lorebook type (packages/shared/src/types/lorebook.ts:48-100) have no position field; 'Prompt Position' appears nowhere in en.json, the lorebook client components or docs/. title: Hand-picked world-generation entries ignore Decision fields (they don't 'read as no')
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:240 - "Entries the user explicitly selects for Game world generation ... bypass the automatic lore token/count budgets and the probability roll ... Decision fields read as no there."
reality: World generation calls processLorebooks with forcedEntriesOnly: true (packages/server/src/routes/game.routes.ts:11262-11286). In processLorebooks, `usesDecisions = !forcedEntriesOnly && ...` (services/lorebook/index.ts:1461; comment 1459-1460: 'An explicit selection (forcedEntriesOnly) is a person's choice and is never gated'), so forcedActivatedEntries pass the decision filter (1571-1573) and a ticked Require or Trigger entry is included regardless of its statement. 'Reads as no' is right for the Game *setup* scan (game.routes.ts:6864, not forcedEntriesOnly, no resolveDecisions) and matches docs/lorebooks/entries.md:144.
fix: lorebooks.md:240: replace 'Decision fields read as no there.' with 'Decision fields are ignored for these hand-picked entries (a ticked Require entry still goes in); Game setup's ordinary lorebook scan reads decision entries as no.'

title: dynamicState is entry-level JSON, not per-chat state
reality: dynamicState is a single JSON column on the entry row (packages/server/src/db/schema/lorebooks.ts:165; written by lorebooks.storage.ts:955, 1056), shared by every chat that uses the entry. Type comment: 'Dynamic state for quests etc. (arbitrary JSON)' (packages/shared/src/types/lorebook.ts:245-246). The engine uses it as metadata, e.g. Game's lorebook keeper tags entries {source, sessionNumber} (game.routes.ts:4064-4105). Per-chat entry state lives in chat metadata (entryStateOverrides for enable/ephemeral, entryTimingStates), not in this field.
fix: Change the row to: 'Arbitrary JSON metadata stored on the entry and shared across chats (e.g. Game's keeper tags session entries). Not per-chat: per-chat enable/ephemeral/timing state is kept in chat metadata.'

title: 'filter mode' row says it governs matching sources; it governs character/tag/trigger filters
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:83 - "*filter mode* | `any` \| `include` \| `exclude` | `any` | `lorebookFilterModeSchema` — governs how the matching sources filter. `include` vs `exclude` changes activation semantics substantially."
reality: lorebookFilterModeSchema is the type of characterFilterMode, characterTagFilterMode and generationTriggerFilterMode (packages/shared/src/schemas/lorebook.schema.ts:201-206); additionalMatchingSources (line 207) has no mode. Semantics (keyword-scanner.ts:324-334): `any` or an empty list passes; `include` passes when at least one listed value is active; `exclude` passes when none is. UI labels are Any / Only / Exclude (LorebookEntryRow.tsx:185-189).
fix: Reword the row: 'Mode shared by the character, character-tag and generation-trigger filters (UI **Any / Only / Exclude**): Any or an empty list = no gate; Only (`include`) = at least one listed value must be active; Exclude = none may be. additionalMatchingSources has no mode.'

title: Activation conditions and schedule are skipped when the chat has no game state
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:339 - "Both conditions must match (AND logic) for the entry to fire. Useful for Game Mode..."; Schedule section (341-352) gives no behavior
reality: evaluateConditions returns true when gameState is null ('No game state = conditions pass (permissive)', packages/server/src/services/lorebook/keyword-scanner.ts:91-93); evaluateSchedule likewise (134-136), and each schedule list is checked only when that state field (time/date/location) is set, as a case-insensitive substring (139-157). Conversation and preset-less Roleplay scans pass a null game state (packages/server/src/routes/generate.routes.ts:3135, 3924). Condition values compare case-insensitively; gt/lt need numbers on both sides or fail; a field missing from a present state compares as ''.
fix: Add after lorebooks.md:339: 'Without a game state (Conversation, and chats with no tracked state) conditions and schedule are skipped and the entry fires on its keys alone, so they gate in Game mode, not in ordinary chats. Comparisons ignore case; gt/lt need numbers; a schedule list applies only when that state field is set (substring match).'

title: Over-budget priority is Constant, then latest-message matches, then order
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:236 - "If more entries match than fit, lower-`order` entries inject first (constant entries and group weighting also factor in) ... configured entry order, not activation method, decides which entries fit when over budget."
reality: lorebookSelectionOrder (packages/server/src/services/lorebook/index.ts:550-556): Constant entries first, then entries whose keys matched the latest user message (semantic matches count as current when a user message exists, keyword-scanner.ts:654-655, 777), then `order`. Each candidate that still fits is added, so a smaller later entry can fit after a larger one is skipped (index.ts:906-913). Group lottery runs before budgeting (keyword-scanner.ts:787), not as a budget factor. A lorebook Token Budget of 0 means no per-lorebook cap (index.ts:772-774). Agrees with docs/lorebooks/token-budgets.md:38-46.
fix: Rewrite the sentence: 'Over budget, entries are tried in this order: Constant, then entries matched in the latest message (keyword or semantic), then by `order`. Each that still fits goes in, so a smaller later entry can fit after a bigger one is skipped. Group winners are picked before this. A lorebook Token Budget of 0 means no per-lorebook cap.'

title: Entry template omits outletName and the character/tag filter fields
skill_evidence: assets/lorebook-entry.template.json - includes generationTriggerFilterMode/Filters but no outletName, characterFilterMode, characterFilterIds, characterTagFilterMode, characterTagFilters
reality: createLorebookEntrySchema (packages/shared/src/schemas/lorebook.schema.ts:201-204, 215) defines outletName (default "", max 200) and the four character/tag filter fields (default "any" / []). All other template fields and defaults match the schema (checked each, incl. probability null, preventRecursion true, decisionMode "off", images []).
fix: Add "outletName": "", "characterFilterMode": "any", "characterFilterIds": [], "characterTagFilterMode": "any", "characterTagFilters": [] to the template, so it covers every user-settable field (position 7 needs outletName).

title: Trigger statements are asked every turn the keywords miss (cost)
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:314 - "**Trigger** — a yes is an extra route in..."; :319 general cost note
reality: A Trigger statement is asked whenever the entry passes its gates (enabled, filters, conditions, timing, probability) and its primary keys miss or the secondary logic rejects them (keyword-scanner.ts:635-662), which is usually every turn. en.json ui.lorebooks.expandeddrawer.decisionTriggerHint: 'Asked every turn while this lorebook is active.' Require is asked only when the entry would activate anyway (decisionRequireHint). Trigger has no effect on a Constant entry, which takes the constant path (keyword-scanner.ts:614-625).
fix: Add to lorebooks.md Decision 'What bites': 'Each Trigger entry spends one statement from the per-turn allowance on every turn its keywords don't match (the drawer says: asked every turn while this lorebook is active); Require is asked only when the entry would activate anyway. Trigger does nothing on a Constant entry.'

title: Entry name is sent to the model with reference images
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:40 - "`name` | string | required | Display name in the UI. Not sent to model."; assets/lorebook-entry.template.json:2 - "(shown in UI, not sent to model)"
reality: An activated entry with reference images sends a user-role message headed 'Visual references for lorebook entry ${entry.name}:' (packages/server/src/services/generation/lorebook-image-prompt.ts:61-64). The Knowledge Router catalog also shows entry names to its model (services/agents/knowledge-router.ts:102-118). Plain text injection does not include the name. Max length 200 (lorebook.schema.ts:187).
fix: lorebooks.md:40: 'Display name (max 200). Not injected with the entry text, but sent as the header of the entry's reference-image message and shown to the Knowledge Router.' Update the template's name comment the same way.
